quiz.question_id: Method apa yang harus diimplementasikan agar sebuah struct menjadi `error` type?
quiz.question_en: Which method must a struct implement to become an `error` type?

quiz.question_id: Mengapa kita perlu mengimplementasikan method Unwrap() pada custom error type?
quiz.question_en: Why should we implement the Unwrap() method on a custom error type?
options_id: Agar errors.Is dan errors.As bisa menelusuri error chain
options_en: So errors.Is and errors.As can traverse the error chain
So the error can be printed
So the error can be compared with ==
So the error can be logged

quiz.question_id: Manfaat utama menggunakan custom error type dibanding errors.New adalah?
quiz.question_en: The main benefit of custom error types over errors.New is?
options_id: Bisa membawa data tambahan seperti kode status, operasi, dll.
options_en: Can carry additional data like status codes, operations, etc.
